result.instructions: Tools for Lightspeed Retail, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lightspeed Retail data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lightspeedrseries_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lightspeedrseries_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lightspeedrseries_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lightspeedrseries_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The connected Lightspeed Retail (R-Series) account: id, name, status, employee count/limit, default and purchasing currencies. Good first call. GET /Account/{accountID}.json.

tools.name: list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List the account's shops (store locations): shopID, name, time zone, archived flag. Use shopID to filter sales, inventory and purchase orders. GET /Account/{accountID}/Shop.json.

include_contact.description: Also load each shop's Contact (address, phone).

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: shopID.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: Search the product catalog. Each item has itemID, description, SKUs (systemSku, customSku, upc, ean, manufacturerSku), defaultCost, categoryID and its Prices (price levels). Set include_stock to add per-shop quantities (ItemShops; shopID 0 = all shops). Paginate with next_url. GET /Account/{accountID}/Item.json.

item_code.description: Exact match on itemID, UPC or EAN.

system_sku.description: Exact Lightspeed system SKU (the barcode on labels).

vendor_id.description: Only items whose default vendor is this vendorID.

modified_since.description: Only items modified at or after this time (item timeStamp, UTC unless an offset is given).

min_qoh.description: Only items with at least one shop record whose quantity on hand is >= this (loads ItemShops).

archived.description: false (default) = active records only, true = active and archived, only = archived only.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: itemID, timeStamp, description.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: One item by itemID with its prices, per-shop stock (ItemShops), category and other related records. GET /Account/{accountID}/Item/{itemID}.json.

relations.description: Related records to include (each adds a little to the request's rate-limit cost). Default: ItemShops, Category, Manufacturer, ItemVendorNums, Note. Allowed: Category, TaxClass, ItemAttributes, ItemAttributes.ItemAttributeSet, Manufacturer, Note, Images, ItemShops, ItemVendorNums, ItemComponents, ItemECommerce, TagRelations, TagRelations.Tag, CustomFieldValues, CustomFieldValues.value, ItemPrices.

tools.name: list_inventory
tools.title: List inventory levels
tools.description: Stock levels per item per shop (ItemShop records): qoh (quantity on hand), sellable, backorder, reorderPoint, reorderLevel, costs and values. shopID 0 is the all-shops summary. Paginate with next_url. GET /Account/{accountID}/ItemShop.json.

shop_id.description: Only this shop (shopID; 0 = the all-shops summary records).

max_qoh.description: Quantity on hand <= this (e.g. 0 for out of stock).

modified_since.description: Only records changed at or after this time (timeStamp).

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: itemShopID, timeStamp.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Item categories (hierarchical): categoryID, name, fullPathName, parentID, nodeDepth. GET /Account/{accountID}/Category.json.

parent_id.description: Only direct children of this categoryID (0 = top level).

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: categoryID, timeStamp, leftNode, rightNode.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: Sales history: saleID, completed/voided flags, completeTime, totals (calcSubtotal, calcTax1/2, total, balance), customerID, employeeID, shopID, registerID. Filter by a date range on completeTime (default) or timeStamp, shop, customer, employee. Set include_lines for SaleLines (items sold). Paginate with next_url. GET /Account/{accountID}/Sale.json.

from.description: Start (inclusive), e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00. Times are UTC unless an offset is given.

date_field.description: Which date from/to apply to (default completeTime).

employee_id.description: Only sales processed by this employee (employeeID).

completed.description: true = completed sales only, false = open/unfinished only.

voided.description: true = voided only, false = exclude voided.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: saleID, timeStamp, completeTime, updatetime.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: get_sale
tools.title: Get a sale
tools.description: One sale by saleID with its line items (SaleLines with Item), payments (SalePayments with PaymentType) and customer. GET /Account/{accountID}/Sale/{saleID}.json.

relations.description: Related records to include (each adds a little to the request's rate-limit cost). Default: SaleLines, SaleLines.Item, SalePayments, SalePayments.PaymentType, Customer. Allowed: SaleLines, SaleLines.Discount, SaleLines.TaxClass, SaleLines.Note, SaleLines.Item, SaleLines.InventorySales, SaleNotes, SalePayments, SalePayments.PaymentType, SalePayments.CCCharge, SalePayments.SaleAccounts, SalePayments.Signatures, ShipTo, ShipTo.Contact, Customer, Customer.Contact, Discount, TaxCategory, TaxCategory.TaxCategoryClasses, Quote.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search customers by name, company or email: customerID, firstName, lastName, company, customerTypeID, createTime. Email search loads the Contact relation (emails, phones, addresses). Paginate with next_url. GET /Account/{accountID}/Customer.json.

include_contact.description: Include the Contact relation (emails, phones, addresses).

archived.description: false (default) = active records only, true = active and archived, only = archived only.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: customerID, timeStamp, firstName, lastName.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: One customer by customerID with Contact (emails, phones, addresses), customer type and notes. GET /Account/{accountID}/Customer/{customerID}.json.

relations.description: Related records to include (each adds a little to the request's rate-limit cost). Default: Contact, CustomerType, Note. Allowed: Contact, CustomerType, Discount, Note, TaxCategory, CreditAccount, Tags, CustomFieldValues, CustomFieldValues.value.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: Suppliers: vendorID, name, accountNumber, archived. GET /Account/{accountID}/Vendor.json.

archived.description: false (default) = active records only, true = active and archived, only = archived only.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: vendorID, timeStamp, name.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: Purchase orders to vendors: orderID, vendorID, shopID, orderedDate, arrivalDate, receivedDate, complete, totalQuantity, shipCost. GET /Account/{accountID}/Order.json.

complete.description: true = completed orders only, false = open orders only.

archived.description: false (default) = active records only, true = active and archived, only = archived only.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: orderID, timeStamp.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by orderID with its lines (OrderLines: itemID, quantity, numReceived, price), vendor and shop. GET /Account/{accountID}/Order/{orderID}.json.

relations.description: Related records to include (each adds a little to the request's rate-limit cost). Default: OrderLines, Vendor, Shop, Note. Allowed: OrderLines, Note, Vendor, Shop, CustomFieldValues, CustomFieldValues.value.

tools.name: list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: Employees: employeeID, firstName, lastName, lockOut, archived, employeeRoleID, limitToShopID. Use employeeID to filter sales. GET /Account/{accountID}/Employee.json.

archived.description: false (default) = active records only, true = active and archived, only = archived only.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: employeeID, timeStamp.

next_url.description: To get the next page: the next_url value from a previous call of this same tool, unchanged. Other filters are ignored when it is set.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer, optionally with a primary email and one phone number (stored in the customer's Contact). Give at least a first name, last name or company. Returns the new customer with its customerID. POST /Account/{accountID}/Customer.json.

tools.name: update_item
tools.title: Update an item
tools.description: Change fields of an existing item: description, default cost, SKUs, category. Only the fields you pass are changed. Prices and stock are not changed here (use update_stock for quantities). PUT /Account/{accountID}/Item/{itemID}.json.

description.description: New description (shown on receipts and labels).

tools.name: update_stock
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: CHANGES STOCK COUNTS: sets (does not add to) the quantity on hand of one item in one shop to `qoh`, by updating the item's ItemShop record. Use for correcting a few items; for many items use an inventory count in Lightspeed. Identify the shop by shop_id, or by item_shop_id from get_item's ItemShops. Not for shopID 0 (the all-shops summary). PUT /Account/{accountID}/Item/{itemID}.json with ItemShops.

shop_id.description: The shopID whose stock to set (from list_shops).

item_shop_id.description: Or the itemShopID of that item/shop record (from get_item ItemShops).
